items.informal_name: Weighted Order Lower Bound for Substituted Multivariate Power Series
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing R] {τ : Type u_4} {S : Type u_5} [inst_1 : CommRing S]
  [inst_2 : Algebra R S] {a : σ → MvPowerSeries τ S} (w : τ → ℕ),
  MvPowerSeries.HasSubst a →
    ∀ (f : MvPowerSeries σ R),
      ⨅ d, ⨅ (_ : (MvPowerSeries.coeff d) f ≠ 0), (Finsupp.weight (MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w ∘ a)) d ≤
        MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w (MvPowerSeries.subst a f)
items.informal_description: For a multivariate power series $ f $ over a commutative ring $ R $ with variables indexed by $ \sigma $, and a substitution map $ a: \sigma \to \mathrm{MvPowerSeries}(\tau, S) $ satisfying the substitution condition, the weighted order of the substituted series $ f[a] $ with respect to a weight function $ w: \tau \to \mathbb{N} $ is greater than or equal to the infimum of the weighted orders of the individual substitutions $ a(x) $ (composed with $ w $) over all non-zero coefficients of $ f $. Formally, $ \inf_{\substack{d \in \sigma \to_0 \mathbb{N} \\ \mathrm{coeff}_d(f) \neq 0}} \mathrm{weightedOrder}(w \circ a, d) \leq \mathrm{weightedOrder}(w, f[a]) $. This establishes a lower bound on the weighted order after substitution in terms of the substitution maps' weighted orders.

items.informal_name: Weighted Order Non-Increasing Under Substitution in Multivariate Power Series
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing R] {τ : Type u_4} {S : Type u_5} [inst_1 : CommRing S]
  [inst_2 : Algebra R S] {a : σ → MvPowerSeries τ S} (w : τ → ℕ),
  MvPowerSeries.HasSubst a →
    (∀ (i : σ), a i ≠ 0) →
      ∀ (f : MvPowerSeries σ R),
        MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder (ENat.toNat ∘ MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w ∘ a) f ≤
          MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w (MvPowerSeries.subst a f)
items.informal_description: For any multivariate power series $ f $ over a commutative ring $ R $ with variables indexed by $ \sigma $, and for any substitution $ a : \sigma \to \mathrm{MvPowerSeries}(\tau, S) $ satisfying the substitution condition and with each $ a(i) \neq 0 $, the weighted order of $ f $ with respect to the weight function $ \mathbb{N}^{\top} \to \mathbb{N} $ composed with the weighted orders of $ a(i) $ is less than or equal to the weighted order of the substituted power series $ f(a) $ with respect to the original weight function $ w $.

items.informal_name: Weighted Order Inequality for Power Series Substitution
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] {τ : Type u_3} {S : Type u_4} [inst_1 : CommRing S] [inst_2 : Algebra R S]
  {a : MvPowerSeries τ S} (w : τ → ℕ),
  PowerSeries.HasSubst a →
    ∀ (f : PowerSeries R),
      f.order * MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w a ≤ MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w (PowerSeries.subst a f)
items.informal_description: For any weight function $ w : \tau \to \mathbb{N} $, a multivariate power series $ a $ over a ring $ S $ with nilpotent constant term, and a univariate power series $ f $ over a commutative ring $ R $, the weighted order of the substituted power series $ f(a) $ with respect to $ w $ is at least the product of the order of $ f $ and the weighted order of $ a $ with respect to $ w $. Formally, $ \text{ord}(f) \cdot \text{ord}_w(a) \leq \text{ord}_w(f(a)) $.

items.informal_name: Coefficient of Taylor Expansion at $ r $: $ \text{coeff}_n(f(X + r)) = D^{(n)}f(r) $
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (r : R) (f : Polynomial R) (n : ℕ),
  ((Polynomial.taylor r) f).coeff n = Polynomial.eval r ((Polynomial.hasseDeriv n) f)
items.informal_description: For any polynomial $ f $ over a semiring $ R $, natural number $ n $, and element $ r \in R $, the coefficient of $ X^n $ in the Taylor expansion $ f(X + r) $ equals the evaluation of the $ n $-th Hasse derivative of $ f $ at $ r $. The Hasse derivative $ D^{(n)} $ scales monomials $ a_i X^i $ by $ \binom{i}{n} a_i X^{i - n} $.

items.informal_name: Big O Estimate for the Difference of Taylor Composed Formal Multilinear Series
items.informal_description: Let $ \mathbb{K} $ be a nontrivially normed field, and let $ E, F, G $ be normed vector spaces over $ \mathbb{K} $. For formal multilinear series $ p_1, p_2: \alpha \to \mathcal{F}(F^k, G) $ and $ q_1, q_2: \alpha \to \mathcal{F}(E^{k_m}, F) $, if the norms of $ p_1(a)k - p_2(a)k $ and $ q_1(a)k - q_2(a)k $ are $ O(f) $ with respect to a filter $ l $ for all $ k \leq n $, and the norms of $ p_1(a)k, p_2(a)k, q_1(a)k, q_2(a)k $ are uniformly bounded for $ k \leq n $, then the difference between the $ n $-th Taylor compositions $ (p_1(a) \circ q_1(a))_n $ and $ (p_2(a) \circ q_2(a))_n $ is also $ O(f) $ with respect to $ l $. Here, $ \mathcal{F} $ denotes the space of formal multilinear series, and $ O(f) $ denotes asymptotic dominance.
